text: I’m a man, 26, never circumcised. Couldn’t pull my foreskin back all the way up to about 17—needed some effort to do it. When I finally did, found a white or yellowish layer underneath. Cleaned it out and now keep up with washing using soap and water. Still, anytime I don’t clean for a while, like on camping trips, the white stuff comes back below the foreskin. Is this more like a yeast issue or something different?

hi two sunrises back, heavy tiredness set in then a runny nose arrived now this has reached my chest and coughing brings stuff up my voice began to fade last evening and it’s still raspy unsure if this points to the flu or a cold or if someone should look at this

Meri cousin Kalpana padhai ka bojh mehsoos karti hai aur aksar udasi mein rehti hai. Har samay bolti hai ki woh kuch nahi kar paayegi, sab kuch khatam ho gaya, maine jyada garv kiya isliye mujhe is sab ka samna karna pad raha hai. Fir woh aksar ro bhi padti hai. Kya tarike ho sakte hain jisse woh apne aap ko phir se thoda theek mehsoos kar sake?

I have asthma and today began using inhaled medicines, antibiotics, breathing treatments, and something for cough. Eight sunsets before today, a strong headache came on that someone mentioned was a migraine, though I’ve never had one before. At that point, cold-like symptoms were not present. Six sunsets before today, a cough and sore throat showed up along with laryngitis. These symptoms remain, and today my breathing was much tougher, leading me to go get medical care. My asthma has shifted quite a bit over the past twelve moon cycles. During the last three cycles of the moon, my voice went away twice with symptoms similar to now. I’m wondering if serious headaches and a disappearing voice could mean an asthma flare-up is on the horizon. I also notice my chin gets itchy when I cough, which is hard to describe.

my little one is three and keeps crying, saying his tummy hurts, there is aching in the area above his neck, the area he sees with is sore, and his legs hurt too. there is a fever. i tried cool compresses and the fever dropped for a bit but now it seems to be coming back. what could this point to and what should i try now?

Neck discomfort that travels down to my lower back on one side, with strong exhaustion and a heavy sensation in my stomach area. I feel unwell, my stomach feels tight, and the lower part of my belly is sore if touched. My muscles feel weak as well. Give some suggestions for this.

Three sunsets back I received a Typhoid Fever diagnosis. I spotted dark brown stool, which appeared because of internal bleeding. After this, I consulted a medical professional who prescribed some tablets. Despite three sunsets on those, I remain weak, extremely tired, unable to manage daily chores, and my drive for intimacy has dropped. Is it typical for this to occur after Typhoid, or is there a chance something different is happening?

My uncle has scarring on his lungs. About 84 months before now, a stent went in for him. Since then, things have usually been smooth except for chest infections here and there that settle after he gets anti biotics. For roughly 12 weeks, he’s had symptoms a bit like a cold that haven’t cleared up yet. He’s 86, slim, and doesn’t struggle with weight. His height is around 5 foot 8 inches.

Details: 43, female, physically active, slim build. For two mornings now, there’s heaviness and soreness through the chest, with aches moving into shoulder and around neck. My pulse flutters and skips at times. There’s tiredness and weakness. My mother deals with chest tightness due to less flow through her vessels, so I wonder if this could be the same thing. My usual medical visit is set for seven sunsets from now. Should I wait for that or go now to the emergency building?

Looking for input from a specialist who deals with the body's circulatory pump. I am 44 and my weight is 106 kg. My father passed away last calendar cycle during surgery for blocked vessels. Three calendar cycles back, high readings on my circulatory numbers began (my weight was 130 kg at that point) and I began taking attacand 4 mg. Using this, my usual readings stayed near 135/85. Five cycles back, I began to notice sudden spinning sensations and higher readings. My treatment was changed to Concor 5 mg. My schedule is often packed, and when I am under pressure during long meetings, the same symptoms tend to return.

Seventeen summers earlier, I was told I have M.S., specifically RRMS. Lately, tiredness hits hard, headaches linger, and now and then I get a burning spot on my forearm. Not too far back, I took a tough spill, picked up a concussion, and after an MRI the report shared there’s a white matter mass close to my frontal horn. Can you go over how being near that spot can show up for someone? My memory and balance both seem different since all this happened.

Trying to have a baby using sperm stored from my husband who passed away. No meeting so far with a fertility specialist. The storage place where the sperm is kept mentioned there is a one in a million chance for pregnancy. Sperm check shows about 15 percent still look alive. Is the chance really that low, or could pregnancy still happen with this amount?

I have a red spot on the breast that’s been there quite a while—it bleeds easily and has slowly gotten larger. About two months back, it bled again and now a small bit of tissue pokes out from the center. Removal by a specialist is planned for next week. Tell me what usually happens during this sort of removal, if concerns about cancer are reasonable, and what kind of soreness or discomfort to expect after the spot is gone.

My name is Katrina. I am a woman, 45. For three trips around the sun, I have struggled with Melasma. I tried melacare and betnovate for a while but the spots remain. I also tried some homeopathy. Suggest a cream that can truly fade Melasma.

My sister has stage 4 cervical cancer, it has spread to all her lymp nodes, there is a tumor on her uterus, and masses in her lungs. No treatment is being suggested. How long might she survive in this situation?

I found out I have spondylolisthesis/spondylosis about 5 seasons back after playing sports. Since wrapping up my time with college softball, I still deal with strong discomfort in my lower back plus a sharp feeling that shoots down the same side leg. The sensation is in my lower back, along the outer side of my thigh, and continues to the outer area below my knee—all on the same side. Most of my shift is spent standing up. Could this discomfort be because of my earlier spine issue, or might another issue be causing these feelings?

I had bronchitis before. Breathing gets tough when I run, exercise, get really excited, or the weather gets cold. I have to stop moving and wait for things to calm down. Is there something I can do to stop this from happening?
For three nights, itchy bumps keep turning up under the surface all over me—on my arm, back, chest, and above one eye. Nothing in my usual routine or things I use has changed.

Had a scan for my stomach because of diarrhea that comes and goes, sometimes it hurts, along with lots of gas and acid issues. The scan report mentions: Mild impairment of echotexture seen in the organ that filters toxins and helps digestion. What could this be about? Yunus.

I’m 18. Yellowing in skin and eyes has stuck around almost 21 days. I visited two people for medical guidance—one is my family regular who suggested avoiding some foods, while the other, a specialist, encouraged me to eat anything including meat, as long as it isn’t cooked in a lot of oil. Their guidance disagrees, so I’m confused. Can you help clear this up?

I am 57 and for about twelve weeks, I keep getting out of breath during physical things and begin to wheeze almost every time I lie down to sleep. I’ve also noticed a cough during sleep hours, plus a sensation in my chest similar to Vicks or like taking a breath of cold air. I’ve seen my regular health provider about three times for these symptoms. I am struggling with this and getting frustrated. What could cause these symptoms?

My cousin, who is 11, received a dog bite from our pet in December 2009. She received 4 Verorab injections as well as anti-rabies serum and an anti-tetanus toxoid after the bite. Our dog is current on all rabies vaccinations and received another rabies vaccination on December 29, 2010. Tonight (July 10), my cousin received another bite from our dog — this time only a small scratch on her lower lip. Should she need the 4 Verorab injections again after this incident?

A friend has tiny bugs coming out from inside the body, mainly from places like the area where people see and the area used to go to the toilet. The bugs are very small and people cannot spot them without something to look closely. What things could lead to this, and what ways are there to treat or get rid of it?

Looking for steps to handle a wisdom tooth that split in two. The inside is open to air and food, but removal isn’t something I’m choosing now. Need practical ways to keep the space clean, any gels or medicines that could give a layer of protection or support healing. Any safe steps or routines would be helpful.

Has anyone else dealt with hydrocephalus from very early childhood and later dealt with seizure episodes, possibly tied to shifts in electrical patterns in the brain? My hydrocephalus first showed up when I was 3 months old, and now I’m 55. My first seizure was at 17. Several medicines are part of my daily routine, and I have a vagus nerve stimulator as well. If more details are useful, mention what is needed.

Never been to see a women’s health specialist before. I’m 31. Been together with my partner for 6 rotations around the sun, always together without barriers, but still no baby. I’m scared something might stop me from welcoming a child, which is what I wish for most. My cycle arrives each turn of the calendar, usually roughly a week after I think it will, but it does show up regularly.

When I was very young, I noticed that when something sharp—like a cat’s claw—makes contact with certain places on my body, I sense the touch in a totally different area (for instance, if touched near my ribs on one side, the sensation shows up in my elbow on the same side). Nobody around me, including health specialists, seems to recognize this at all. Back in 1996, someone said that my health trouble matched Fibromyalgia, which is known for trouble with nerves. I also have patches that suddenly turn warm and damp for no clear reason. Could there be another explanation that fits all of these signs? Or is Fibromyalgia still a likely match? Do these experiences go along with a specific health issue?

I’ve had two clots before and there’s a mark with a white spot in it on my elbow. The mark appeared roughly a week back but the spot only started to stand out over the past couple. I can’t remember hitting my elbow, and my most recent inr result was 2.9 from 9/25/14. Is this something to be concerned about?

Implanon has been under my skin since november 2010. Over the past several evenings my arm and hand on the same side as the device started to turn quite numb and tingly. Nothing else has happened. Does this sort of thing need concern?

Red, pimply outbreak along shoulders and upper back for about five mornings. Tried cortisone and diphenhydramine but bumps have not faded. Now the whole body feels prickly—not only the spots with the outbreak. My body often reacts quickly to soaps, detergents, and plants. Sensitive to many things like that. Spent last weekend outside camping. Is it possible this started from touching something outdoors? What might cause this? Please share some guidance.

Healthy woman, 36. For over 5 full moons now, there’s a sharp and constant ache in mid to upper back, near or just under collarbone. This unwelcome sensation never goes away. It seems stronger as the sun moves across the sky and gets worse if I breathe in deeply, but it lessens with anti-inflammatory tablets. My breathing is fine otherwise. If no major health issues are behind this, what simple causes could this have, and is this something that needs to worry me?

Hi. Stephen here in Kuwait. I began Neoclav 625mg—third tablet since yesterday—to treat a swollen gum and a painful lower molar. After visiting a dentist at the Ministry of Health today, I received prescriptions for three different tablets: Ospamox (Sandoz) 500mg, Suprazole 200mg, and Iprofen 400mg. Ospamox is meant to be used the same way as Neoclav (one tablet every eight hours for five cycles), while Suprazole and Iprofen are both one tablet three times daily for five cycles. Should I switch to Ospamox, or keep going with Neoclav?

My son, who is 14, returned from school yesterday mentioning discomfort behind his vision, a sore head, and queasiness. Yesterday, he had meals and drinks as usual, but today after school he hardly ate, took in plenty of liquids, and lay down straight away. We are African, staying in the UK. I read about more cases of West Nile flu in this place. Is it important to take him to the hospital soon? He does not have a temperature but feels very drained.

Had a lower spine procedure after an MRI in June, but there’s still no relief for severe discomfort and muscle cramping on one leg—Lyrica 75 mg takes the edge off, but I still can’t stand or walk properly, and my toes are numb. If I move more than about 25 feet, there’s intense distress in the other leg. Now a sore is showing up on one toe; one specialist thinks a vascular specialist should take a look. The bone specialist requests another MRI to figure things out. I keep sharing with the care team that discomfort is worse on one side. Someone mentioned a cyst on one ovary in 1994. Should I ask a women’s health specialist if that could be the source of nerve symptoms and leg trouble?

Hi, I keep having strong discomfort in my chest and it’s really hard to breathe. After seeing a medical professional, two scans happened—one for my chest and another for my lower belly. The results show my kidney and spleen are larger than usual and there are swollen lymph nodes in my chest. The medical professional isn’t sure why I’m hurting and gave something for the hurt and an antibiotic. What steps do I take now? This hurts more than I can take.

My pulse stays above 120 for around 6 to 7 at a time. Came down with a bad cold or flu, have a fever. Took diltiazem 360 about two back. Drinking plenty of fluids. No way to measure my temperature right now. Been unwell for about three. Using Tylenol 500 MG, plus both dayquil and nyquil. Ativan is also on hand.

I slept with my boyfriend after almost a week without doing it. About an hour after, I woke up with a strong ache low in my belly. When I used the bathroom, it stung while I was peeing. That ache in my lower belly is still there and gets worse if I sit down hard. What might be causing this?

I take 5mg Ramapril every day to help keep my numbers down, but yesterday even after taking it my reading was 172 over 80 or maybe 90. I have an ECG and some checks coming up next week. Since the nurse mentioned this, my anxiety has shot up and I barely slept. My anxiety is already something I manage. Is it safe for me to use KALMS too? I think my numbers are still high. I also use amitriptyline for discomfort and penicillin because my spleen has been removed.

Sharp stabs on the same side of my skull come and go through each twenty-four-hour stretch—it’s been happening all week. Swelling appeared around the same eye today when I woke up, noticed by my spouse as well. Up until this, only two or three headaches ever. Two summers earlier, a melanoma came off my forearm. Could this be urgent?

There is a rash at the tip and some down the foreskin of my penis. I never notice any discomfort or itching. My partner had a bladder sling put in, with a cut made after, which means there is now a sharp spot inside her that can sometimes scratch me. What could lead to this?

22, female. For several weeks, feeling tightness in my chest, with more discomfort whenever I lie down. When this first showed up, I visited both a clinic and a hospital. Tests and xrays found nothing unusual. Other than this issue, I feel healthy and exercise five times weekly. Looking for thoughts and direction.

Gall bladder and appendix removed some time back. For about a week now there’s been very sharp discomfort around my bellybutton, almost like someone’s pushing out from the inside. Sometimes it gets so strong that breathing is tough. This comes up every single time, sometimes more intense. When I lie down, there’s a heavy feeling in the same area and it gets worse if I press or touch it. Neck surgery recovery is still ongoing so I’m not lifting anything over 10 lbs or moving much.

What numbers are usually seen for glucose in someone who is 17 and weighs 187 pounds? She seems less focused and tired lately, so I started looking into this. I realize weight matters, but I am looking for the usual range.

hi, my husband hurt his knee some time back and it is slowly improving, but now all the muscles in both his arms and legs are extremely sore. he can barely lift his arms because of this. he’s taking ibuprofen and flexeril regularly which eases things a little but he’s still very uncomfortable.

My name is Prashant. Weight is 115kg and I am 5.65ft tall. Two separate times, the numbers for my heart and arteries climbed to 150 over 100. I took tablets for this three times after those increases. The readings have stayed the same for the past two weeks. Exercise on a treadmill showed no issues. A medical professional suggested Nabistar 2.5 to help with tension from my job. Should I begin this tablet? Will I need to keep taking it always? Please share what I should do.

Fourth sunrise with a kidney infection. For the first three sunrises, I drank lots of extra fluids, but the urge to go stayed strong and only a small amount came out each time. This sunrise, without extra fluids, I am going more often and the amount is up, all of it completely clear. This is also the second sunrise on my antibiotic. I am not pushing extra fluids, but still sipping, and a bit of dryness in my mouth. Could this shift be from the medicine starting to do its thing, or might there be another reason?

Fighting off amoebiasis again and again, symptoms stick around about a quarter of a year now. Been to a few clinics, each gave pills like ciprofloxacin, tinidazole, metrogyl, some stomach acid tablet, and entero quinal. Relief shows up for a bit during the course, but then the same troubles return once the packets run out. Also there’s plenty of itchiness near my back passage. What steps can I try next to settle this?

Since 2021 I underwent gallbladder removal, then a hysterectomy, had a parotid tumor removed this January, first noticed thyroid troubles in May, and now there’s a lump on my collarbone along with knots in my shoulder. Could there be a connection among all these physical issues, and what might bring them on?

I am 23 and in my 33rd week of pregnancy. I had to go into hospital and stay overnight because my pulse jumped to 205. They managed to bring it down, but it remains over 100. I feel anxious about this happening again. What could cause this, and what are the next steps for me? Nikkita.

Man, 42, went through bladder and prostate cancer in the past and still gets care for growths in the bladder. Had gallbladder removed in February, then had to stay in a hospital in March with clots below the waist. Since that time, even after seeing both a stomach specialist and the usual medical provider, along with getting a CT scan and X-ray, nobody explained why there are strange feelings high up in the upper belly where the gallbladder sat. Pushing under the ribs in that spot usually means a quick trip to the restroom is needed right after. In 2007, it took nearly two full trips around the sun before someone realized cancer caused those symptoms. Even now, no explanation for this issue has surfaced. Need ideas on who else can help sort this out.

My lab tests show LDS is 222 and d-dimer is 0.51. My lower legs feel swollen and sore, and breathing is difficult. Yesterday, a venous doppler scan checked my legs but no clots were found. I am 31, 5 feet 2 inches tall, heavier than what is usually suggested, and I am generally healthy. What steps would normally follow? Are these results connected?

hi, 22, sudden soreness in my testicle on one side. at first it felt like getting hit there, now the soreness seems to move along the veins. lab tests and ultrasound didn’t find anything unusual. what might be causing this soreness?

my little boy is three. He uses seroflo inhaler for nearly six weeks now, and asthalin inhaler only when necessary. During this stretch, asthalin got given for about five or six in a row as suggested by the medical person. After that, the medical person mentioned sal mucolite, and we gave that for almost five. His cough sticks around. Getting anxious since my little boy seems to always need some medicine for different things. please guide me.

A long time back, I got a tick bite close to my hairline on one side of my neck and I thought I pulled it out completely. After some time, a large bump formed just under the surface, near my neck bone in that same place. This bump keeps getting bigger—still under the surface—and the soreness is worse. This spot was clear before the bite. Since the soreness is increasing, I’m uneasy about what’s happening. Looking for thoughts on what this could mean.

Lifted a weighted bar and felt something pop along the side of my wrist near the pinky. At first, it wasn’t too strong, but later, discomfort woke me up more than once. There’s swelling and a lot of tenderness around the bump at the base of my wrist. Twisting my arm or picking up objects really hurts. Wondering if this might be a bad sprain or something else.

I am nearly 26 and first picked up smoking at 12, spent a lot of time with smokers when I was younger too. My arms and legs tingle and often lose feeling even when I sit or lie down. I see pale patches under the surface on my legs, showed up on the backs of my calves around 16 and now there are more elsewhere on my legs. After a trip from Australia to the UK, my chest pounded hard, my arm on one side really ached, and I got aches through my hips and legs. These problems faded after several months, then came back after a shorter plane trip to Spain, and again after another long journey from the UK to Brazil—each time my arms and legs felt heavy and sore. What are some things I can try on my own for better flow in my body, or should I find a medical expert? I am not familiar with nutrition or planning meals, so could you explain simple eating choices, what foods are useful, what to limit, and how much or how often each week I should eat those? Please add what kinds of physical activity might suit my situation.
The radiologist sent me my CT spinal scan results.

Male, 21, found a soft lump in the middle of the chest after waking up. It sits between the area above the abs and below the chest muscles and is about the size of a golf ball. Feels like jelly. Not painful unless pushed, then a little bit sensitive. Otherwise, barely noticeable. Looking for possible reasons this could happen. Name: Adam.

checking chances of a baby with semen check results: sperm count is 33 million per ml, 99 million for each release, moving sperm 39%, fast straight movement 4%, slow or not direct 46%, not progressing 50%. after 3 spins around the sun, no baby yet. are these numbers okay for a baby? if not, what should be done?

My toddler is 1 with a weight of 12 kg. She has a high temperature and coughing that has lasted quite some time. Her white cell number is 19000. She was given Cepodem 5 ml once per 24 hours. After each dose, she throws up and her coughing is more severe. Should she keep getting this medicine? Is this medicine safe?

A child who is ten has stomach aches that come and go, more often than the headaches or sore throat she also gets sometimes. These belly aches happen the most. I have watched what she eats and how much food she gets. A health worker mentioned before she could be a bit clogged up inside. She is able to go to the bathroom. What could make things better? Could this be connected to her body nearing its first period?

Both shoulders are now very stiff and sore, much like adhesive capsulitis, and upper arm discomfort is keeping me awake. In the past, therapy sorted out each shoulder but this episode feels unlike before—no loss of strength but instead a lot of soreness, trouble moving, and sharp aches running down both arms. I’ve been under a lot of stress after moving my mother who is 94, over a distance of 1300 miles. Could stress and the move be causing all this soreness and stiffness? Is it possible to manage this on my own at home without seeing a therapist? I am 69.

Told by a medical professional that I have chronic bronchitis and copd a little over a month back. Using three different steroids and taking armour thyroid tablets. Breathing is still getting worse. Completed three rounds of antibiotics. Stopped dexamethasone yesterday. Whole body feels awful. Also dealing with adrenal insufficiency. Now my tongue burns and looks dark in color. Could quickly stopping steroids put me in serious danger? My stomach is much bigger than usual. Considering prednisone. Noticed a red rash on both chest and face.

Lower side of the belly on the lower side hurts, sticking around almost three-seven days. Two trips to the emergency place happened, with checks of blood, scans, and belly ultrasounds but nothing explained why. Regular care person also sent for more checks, including pictures of the stomach and intestines, with no clear answer yet. That led to a visit suggestion for someone who deals with female health—one said it could be muscles or bowels, another agreed, so the primary care person sent a referral to someone who looks at eating and digestion. Meeting with the gut specialist is coming soon, with the possibility of a scope being used to look inside. Despite all of this, a strong sense inside says this could be tied to female health since the emergency visit came with serious pain and a bit of spotting. Energy is very low, emotions are rough, and a sense of confusion is strong—hoping for thoughts or guidance since nothing so far explains it.

My mother is around 63 and has had diabetes for roughly two decades. Over the last twelve months, she started dealing with severe rheumatoid arthritis and has been on medicine for that. Her ESR stays close to 90. Fourteen to sixteen weeks back, she developed sudden kidney trouble with her creatinine number going up to 3 due to dehydration, and she received treatment. Her creatinine and sugar results are both in the usual range now. Since that incident, her urine checks have shown high pus cells at different times—sometimes 8-10 hpf, sometimes 10-20 hpf, sometimes 20-30 hpf, and in some cases even higher, around 30-40 hpf. She took a course of antibiotics as instructed (three doses), but the pus cells continue to show up.

Can you share any natural ways or practical suggestions that could assist her in moving past this ongoing situation?

I’m eighteen with relatives who have had cholesterol problems and heart troubles. Sometimes I notice sudden muscle jerks in my thigh and arm on one side that match my pulse. When this happens, the beat is strong enough to make the area visibly move. The sensation is like something is moving through with a lot of force. Should I be concerned about this?

I am fifty-four and have heard many times since my twenties that I deal with costochondritis. I used to deliver mail and carried a heavy bag over one shoulder while doing that. I also get disability checks because of SI Joint Dysfunction. For the past three all twelve stretches, bumps keep popping up on top of my head—some with rough patches—and now one has turned up on my elbow, along with sores inside my mouth, way too much mucous in my throat, and a sense like my palate or throat feels swollen. A throat and ear specialist checked my tonsils first and gave me a special mouth rinse for germs. That helped for a while but the same troubles keep returning. The specialist also used a camera to look down my throat and said nothing unusual could be seen. Six all twelve stretches before now, a tube test down my throat showed there was a yeast issue in my swallowing tube, and I had pills for that. My hands have severe swelling and pain from non-rheumatoid arthritis starting from my twenties, a partway torn shoulder muscle, and pinched nerves in the other because of bone spurs. I keep growing extra bony spots on my fingers too. I asked my joint doctor about psoriatic arthritis because my joints, bands that hold bones, and top layers of my body have all had these same symptoms for a long time. He did not think it fit my case. When the new bump appeared on my elbow and I saw another pop up on my scalp, I requested further checks. The answer given: seborrheic keratosis. For longer than twenty-four fortnights, about once every four weeks or so, I feel like it is tough to catch enough breath. My oxygen checks always show 98 percent. Lung findings are:

Three summers back, I began dealing with intense itching across all parts of my body that has not let up and is making daily life very difficult. I was given Loratadine, which eases things for around four stretches, but then the itching quickly returns. I heard that it's due to my body's reaction to any force or rubbing. On top of this, I’ve been running into repeating diarrhea spells for about four long stretches now, sometimes dragging on for up to two long stretches at a time. Mild headaches and blurry eyesight are mixed in as well. I am 28, and so far I’ve visited over ten different skin specialists. None have come up with an actual fix, even after several different lab checks such as

My body is showing high sugar numbers. A medical professional put me on Fenofibrate 48mg and mentioned avoiding potatoes or noodles. That’s all I heard about this. The bottle label mentions it’s for cholesterol. I am 45 and none of this makes sense to me.

Began cerazette around a fortnight back after a long gap with no contraception. Before this, bleeding usually lasted about five with only one or two heavier patches. Now bleeding has gone beyond a week, steady heavy flow with clots the entire time—color moves between bright red and dark brown. Many more clots than in the past. There’s also a dull ache; using paracetamol at the moment but would rather avoid using too much. Should I stop now or keep going and see if things improve?

Run down with soreness in the chest, and every so often there’s a need to cough for a deeper breath, almost like a quick twitch in the throat. Occasionally, there’s a flutter in the stomach area as well. When out for walks during the winter, the cold made the chest very sore, and even now with warmer temperatures, the soreness is still there, though less often. There’s also some post-nasal drip happening now.

I’ve had blood come up twice from my swallowing tube and both times bands were placed. I’ve also had two shunt surgeries for the organ that filters toxins. How often do these bands need to be placed to reduce the chances of another episode of bleeding?

Looking for details on whether AV Node Ablation could be useful for my mother, who is 81 (she’s active and sharp for someone her age). She’s been having more trouble with shortness of breath these past three months. About 11 years back, she underwent a large bypass surgery with five grafts after a cardiac event, and she already has a device that does both defibrillation and regulates her heartbeat. Until three months back, she was managing on her own and stayed quite active. Lately, her energy is down and the breathing issues keep increasing. Her pulse, vital signs, and oxygen saturation are all steady. She couldn’t stick with Multaq or amiodarone due to strong reactions, but continues on coreg. Looking for info on whether AV Node Ablation could be considered for someone in her situation.

My wife and I married 8 full cycles in the past. We have been trying for a child, but she has not conceived. A medical professional checked her and suggested a capsule called Consevel to take every morning and every evening. She used this medicine for around thirty days, but there has still not been a pregnancy. Since she began these capsules, she has been gaining weight steadily. What could be causing her not to conceive?

I’m a 15-year female. I am 155 cm and 58 kg. I have had a fever that won't go for nearly eight weeks. For the last couple sunsets, there’s a soreness on one side of my belly. The soreness was strong after it began, and now it’s less, but yawning or coughing makes it worse. Nothing like this has happened with my health in the past. I use paracetamol to bring down the fever, but it won’t leave. This all began after I traveled from UAE to India. What are possible reasons for these symptoms?

My name is Soledad. Yesterday after using the restroom and wiping, I saw a light orange stain on the tissue. Today I noticed orange-colored fluid in my underwear, and while wiping there appeared a small spot of light red. What could this mean?

Woke this morning with pounding in my chest. My husband checked my pulse and counted 110 beats every minute. I couldn’t catch my breath and the spot above my belly button felt hard and swollen. I was nauseous—had dry heaves about five times. Felt very weak, but once it passed, my chest was fine again, breathing easier, and that tightness relaxed, though my belly is still bloated. There’s a hernia right there (it was repaired once, but then gave way again, quite a while back). I deal with esophagitis, but this didn’t match my usual symptoms. Am juggling several health problems, and take quite a few pills each day. Something similar happened in the past few weeks, only then there was more dizziness and my fingers tingled for about an hour after.
